package.name: fusion_lab
package.description:
THE REAL-PERCEPTION PRODUCER (Phase 10). LiDAR+camera fusion core (calibration, frustum association, clustering, Go2Rig) plus the adapters that drive it from a recorded Go2 rosbag. Composed by `adapters/go2_producer.py` into: frame -> YOLO -> fuse -> Detection3D -> Tracker -> Track.
It emits the canonical `Track` contract (package `tracking`) and NOTHING else. Dependency direction is one-way: fusion_lab -> tracking. The IT2-FLS controller never imports this package, and this package never imports the controller.
NO rclpy in the core — it is pure numpy, so it survives Foxy (robot) / Humble (dev) / Jazzy (lab) unchanged. ROS appears in exactly one place, the bag reader (adapters/go2_bag.py), which imports rclpy lazily INSIDE a function purely to deserialize recorded messages.
